technique_name: What are the different types of computer viruses?
description: There are several different types of computer viruses including boot sector viruses, file infector viruses, macro viruses, Trojans, worms, ransomware, and adware. Boot sector viruses affect the boot sector of a computer system, while file infector viruses spread themselves by attaching to executable files and modifying them to include a malicious code.
